description.$value: Link colors of the brand mode FR. The plain names are for light surfaces, the names with _inverse for dark surfaces. The link tokens point here, so the brand decides the link colors.

default.$description: Role: Exclusive. Link color, default, light surfaces. FR: fr.ch primary.

default_inverse.$description: Role: Exclusive. Link color, default, dark surfaces. FR: fr.ch dark mode primary.

hover.$description: Role: Exclusive. Link color, hover, light surfaces. FR: fr.ch primary.

hover_inverse.$description: Role: Exclusive. Link color, hover, dark surfaces. FR: fr.ch dark mode primary.

active.$description: Role: Exclusive. Link color, active, light surfaces. FR: fr.ch primary.

active_inverse.$description: Role: Exclusive. Link color, active, dark surfaces. FR: fr.ch dark mode primary.

visited.$description: Role: Exclusive. Link color, visited, light surfaces. FR: same as default, fr.ch does not style visited links.

visited_inverse.$description: Role: Exclusive. Link color, visited, dark surfaces. FR: same as default, fr.ch does not style visited links.

default_max.$description: Role: Exclusive. Link color, default, light surfaces, high contrast: #008094 mixed 50% with black.

default_max_inverse.$description: Role: Exclusive. Link color, default, dark surfaces, high contrast: #57B3C2 mixed 50% with white.

hover_max.$description: Role: Exclusive. Link color, hover, light surfaces, high contrast: #008094 mixed 50% with black.

hover_max_inverse.$description: Role: Exclusive. Link color, hover, dark surfaces, high contrast: #57B3C2 mixed 50% with white.

active_max.$description: Role: Exclusive. Link color, active, light surfaces, high contrast: #008094 mixed 50% with black.

active_max_inverse.$description: Role: Exclusive. Link color, active, dark surfaces, high contrast: #57B3C2 mixed 50% with white.

visited_max.$description: Role: Exclusive. Link color, visited, light surfaces, high contrast: #008094 mixed 50% with black.

visited_max_inverse.$description: Role: Exclusive. Link color, visited, dark surfaces, high contrast: #57B3C2 mixed 50% with white.
